candidates.title: Baoulés
candidates.quote: Chez les Baoulé, le nom de famille est patronymique : le père donne son prénom comme nom de famille à ses enfants. […] Lundi : (Kouassi / Akissi)
candidates.supports: Kouassi is a personal day name (born on Monday) given to an individual, and in the traditional patronymic system the father's personal name becomes his children's family name. candidates.title: Clans du peuple kongo
candidates.quote: …lawu, mankunku, nkunku, nsongo (tsongo, mitsongo)…
candidates.supports: Only partly supports the claim. This French Wikipedia page lists 'nkunku' among the Kongo clans that descend from Nsaku. It introduces the list as 'Voici une liste proposée par Ne Muanda Nsemi' and cites Ne Bitumba (Bundu dia Kongo), 'Les mvila une catégorie philosophique ?', 2004, published in Kinshasa. That supports Nkunku being a Kongo clan name. It does not use the spelling 'Nkounkou', and it does not tie the clan to the Republic of the Congo (COG). It is a weak source: an encyclopedia page drawing on a Bundu dia Kongo writer, not academic work.
